chapel_priest.start: Come in, traveller. The chapel is open to those who need silence — or answers.
longhouse_innkeeper.start: Welcome to the longhouse! Sit by the fire. The mead is from last harvest and the stories are free.
house_a_cook.start: Smells good, doesn't it? Boar stew. And no, you can't taste it — the spoon is mine.
house_a_innkeeper.start: A bed and a hot meal, traveller? Travellers always bring stories — and mud.
house_b_scholar.start: Shh. I'm reading. …There, you lost me the paragraph. What do you want?
house_c_cook.start: More wood for the oven and the bread comes out. Hungry? Come back shortly — or stay and help.
